title: [CI][lint] PR lint did not catch error on main related to pyi files
bug_description:
See https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/159104#issuecomment-3367077208

From what I can tell:
We query for changed files before calling the lint script
The lint script generates pyi files
Lintrunner gets run

On the PR, the generated pyi files don't have lintrunner called on them, but they are on the main branch since it runs on all files

Not sure what the expected behavior is here since the pyi files get generated

cc @seemethere @malfet @pytorch/pytorch-dev-infra
